faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NABCONS Insurance Specialist position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the NABCONS Insurance Specialist recruitment is 12th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Insurance Specialist post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Insurance Specialist position under the NABCONS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Insurance Specialist role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA degree with at least 5 years of experience in the insurance field, including experience in designing insurance products. Strong knowledge of insurance products and underwriting is also required.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Insurance Specialist position?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of candidates, followed by an interview, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Insurance Specialist position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for candidates in Maharashtra, and the city mentioned for the role is Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q8. Does NABCONS offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly provided in the summary. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of NABCONS?
faq.answer: The official website of NABARD Consultancy Services (NABCONS) is www.nabcons.com. Candidates can visit this site for more information and to apply.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this NABCONS Insurance Specialist recruitment is NABCONS/CO-HR/13/PBCS/2026-27.
